Dtech USB 3.0 USB Male to Male Data Cable 1.5M

The Dtech USB 3.0 Male to Male Data Cable (1.5M) is designed for high-speed data transfer between USB-compatible devices. Featuring USB 3.0 technology, this cable offers transfer speeds of up to 5 Gbps—10x faster than USB 2.0—making it perfect for connecting external hard drives, enclosures, printers, and other peripherals to your PC or laptop.


Key Features:

  • High-Speed Performance: USB 3.0 supports data transfer rates up to 5 Gbps, ensuring fast and efficient file transfers.
  • Male to Male Design: Ideal for connecting two USB 3.0 Type-A ports, such as from a computer to an external device or hard drive enclosure.
  • Premium Build Quality: Gold-plated connectors and high-quality shielding reduce interference and ensure a stable connection.
  • Length: 1.5 meters—perfect for desktop setups with just the right amount of reach.
  • Plug & Play: No drivers required; simply connect and start using immediately.
  • Wide Compatibility: Works with USB 3.0 and backward compatible with USB 2.0/1.1 devices (at lower speeds).
